parsed.explanation: The inference |E|<|V| ⇒ no cycle or loop is false; it only guarantees that at least one connected component is a tree. The given n=2 refinement indeed forces a loop at the longest-piece vertex, so the chosen component need not be bipartite and Ξ is not defined as claimed. No independent all-n lower-bound proof appears elsewhere. Replacing the choice of the component containing n by any tree component repairs the argument, since its nonempty vertex set still satisfies (3.1) and the subsequent expansion works unchanged.
